newsitem.title: USA: American Airlines to cut kid fares 50 pct.
newsitem.headline: American Airlines to cut kid fares 50 pct.

text.p: American Airlines, a unit of AMR Corp, announced on Wednesday it will provide a fifty percent fare discount for children under two years of age travelling with an adult.
The fare, good on U.S. domestic and U.S.-Canadian flights is being introduced to encourage the use of child safety seats on airplanes.
Formerly, parents would hold children on their laps which has been found to be dangerous, an American Airlines official said.
"Studies have shown that children being held by adults don't fair as well," said American Airlines vice president of operations Bob Baker.
Baker also said the airline expects revenues to increase minimally from the new offer.
The discounted fares will be good for all published fares including advertised discounts and the purchasing number is unlimited.
